<p>Dear QGIS Community,</p>
<p>We are very pleased to announce that this year’s round of grants is now available. The call is open to anybody who wants to make a funded contribution to QGIS, subject to the call conditions outlined in the application form.</p>
<p>The deadline for this round is <strong>21st March 2021</strong>.</p>
<p>For more details, please read the introduction provided in the <a href="https://forms.gle/5h1XJc3nUTZP4Axh7">application form</a>.</p>
<p>We look forward to seeing all your great ideas for improving QGIS!</p>
